test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

When I was in high school / I participated in several extracurricular activities / such as the debate team and the school newspaper / which help me developed my communication and writing skills.

options.text: When I was in high school
which help me developed my communication and writing skills
such as the debate team and the school newspaper
I participated in several extracurricular activities

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the use of the verb 'help' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be **'helped'** to match the **past tense of the rest of the sentence.**
 
• Additionally, the phrase should be** 'helped me develop'** instead of** 'help me developed'.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: ***When I was in high school, I participated in several extracurricular activities such as the debate team and the school newspaper, which helped me develop __my communication and writing skills*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The verbs in a sentence should be consistent in tense to maintain clarity and coherence.
 
• When referring to past events, ensure that all verbs are in the past tense unless a specific reason for a tense shift is required.
 
• In this case, since the activities and skills development occurred in the past, 'helped' and 'develop' are appropriate.
